title: A Finite Coordinate Reduction for Approachability Loss in Lean
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We explain a Lean 4 development of a finite-coordinate loss-preserving construction motivated by Theorem 4 of Dann, Mansour, Mohri, Schneider, and Sivan. Nonempty finite constraint and action index sets give a joint probability simplex with a canonical action marginal. For each mixed constraint, a linear comparator adds its outer product with that marginal. The comparator has mass two and leaves the legal action set.
